items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: No, no, Ballard, he played with Cootie Williams' band, too.

ctx.x: And Basie heard him, and Basie called him in there and told him, said, "He's going to finish this Strand Theatre. Now, you all want him to start over in the Royal Roost, okay, he starts after this job here." So I finished the Strand. And he came in the Royal Roost.

And so when they finished the job at the Royal Roost, they went out on the road. And they were out on the road a week, and he put his notice in and went and joined Woody Herman's band, Shadow. So Basie was left without a drummer. So he told Rushing to call me. And Rushing said, "No, I ain't going to call him." Said, "You didn't treat him right when he was here." And so they got Butch Ballard.
He's a white boy, isn't he?
